subject: Request: scoped VM evidence + witness for hotpatch (CVE-2028-1456)
messages:
From: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@fintide.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fintide.com
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: scoped VM evidence + witness for hotpatch (CVE-2028-1456)

Hi Naomi,

We're preparing the SIG/SOC2 intake for our upcoming vendor review and we're trying to close the VM section this week. A few asks specific to a recent finding (CVE-2028-1456) we saw in our scan:

- Proof of recurring network/service vulnerability scans for the last 90 days (scan cadence + timestamps).
- SLA statement for remediation timelines by severity (critical/high).
- Evidence that a technical mitigation/hotpatch was applied for CVE-2028-1456, including the patch manifest and a short audit log of the deployment action.
- If possible, we'd like a 20–30 minute recorded session or live witness where your engineer walks us through the hotpatch application and the verification steps.

I've attached the SIG VM worksheet; we populated the questions we care about in the VM section (tab 2). Can you confirm scope and estimate when you can deliver the artifacts? We're aiming to bundle this into our SIG submission by Friday 2028-08-25.

Thanks,
Emma Lopez
Security Program Manager
Fintide Bank
emma.lopez@fintide.com
+1 415 555 0123

Attachment: Fintide-SIG-Questionnaire-vm-section.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@fintide.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: scoped VM evidence + witness for hotpatch (CVE-2028-1456)

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet. We're able to scope this and can deliver a compact evidence package plus a witness session. High-level plan below:

1) Scan cadence artifacts: export of scheduled scan runs for the last 90 days (timestamps + scanner version + targets).
2) SLA statement: short declaration for remediation SLOs (Critical: 72 hours initial response, High: 7 days patch/mitigation) — we'll include the policy doc reference.
3) Hotpatch evidence for CVE-2028-1456: patch manifest (hashes), deployment audit log (who/when), and verification results (post-patch scan showing CVE absent).
4) Witnessing: we can run a 25-minute screen-share on WED 2028-08-22 or THU 2028-08-23; Ben can lead the demo and show the live audit log and artifact hashes.

I'm attaching an initial cadence snapshot (CSV) and a short patch manifest draft for your quick review. If that matches your expectations I'll ask Ben to collect the deployment logs and we can schedule the witness.

Proposed deliverables ETA: artifacts in 48 hours (by 2028-08-22 EOD), witness session 2028-08-22/23 per availability.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Trust & Safety (acting)
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-vm-cadence-snapshot-20280820.csv (csv), cve-2028-1456-patch-manifest.txt (txt)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Emma Lopez <emma@fintide.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: scoped VM evidence + witness for hotpatch (CVE-2028-1456)

Emma / Naomi — looping in the operational evidence. Quick notes:

- Hotpatch was applied in production on 2028-08-20 03:14:22 UTC.
- Patch manifest (attached) includes file-level SHA256 hashes and package versions.
- Deployment audit extract attached (hotpatch-log-20280820.tar.gz) contains the orchestration job stdout and the agent acknowledgement events (redacted for PII).
- Post-patch scan (internal) ran at 2028-08-20 04:05:00 UTC and shows the specific CVE no longer present on affected nodes. I'll include the scan ID in the final package.

For the witness session: happy to do a short live walk-through. Typical agenda:
  - 5m: short context and risk summary
  - 10m: live view of the deployment audit and hashes verified against manifest
  - 10m: show post-patch scan and verification steps + Q&A

Proposed times: 2028-08-22 13:00–13:30 PDT or 2028-08-23 10:00–10:30 PDT. Let me know which works.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
+1 650 555 0199

Attachments: hotpatch-log-20280820.tar.gz (log archive), cve-2028-1456-patch-manifest.txt (txt)

From: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@fintide.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fintide.com
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: scoped VM evidence + witness for hotpatch (CVE-2028-1456)

Thanks — this is helpful and on a good timeline. We can take the artifacts and the witness session. A couple of follow-ups before the demo:

1) Please include a Merkle-root or SHA256 digest of the hotpatch-log archive in the package (so we can verify integrity after receipt).
2) For the SLA statement: please confirm whether your "72 hours initial response for Critical" is an internal SLO or a contractual SLA; if it's an internal SLO we need to see how that maps to contractual language for SIG.
3) For the post-patch scan, please include the specific scan ID and the scanner signature/version used.

We'll take the 2028-08-22 13:00–13:30 PDT slot if you can record for the compliance folder as well. If you prefer the other time, confirm and we'll adjust.

Once we have the artifact hashes and the SLA wording, we'll attach the materials into the SIG packet and close this section.

Best,
Emma
Security Program Manager
Fintide Bank
emma.lopez@fintide.com
